name: Taikong Xingji satellite data center and secondary operations-control center
developer: Zhuzhou Taikong Xingji Satellite Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Xinhua reported the company said it would build a data center and secondary operations-control center in Jiamusi for local satellite data processing; no power or rack capacity disclosed.

name: South Surveying remote sensing data center
notes: Xinhua quoted South Surveying management saying the firm hoped to cooperate with Jiamusi on a surveying-oriented remote-sensing data center as part of the city's satellite industry push.

name: AiHai Northern 5G IoT R&D intelligent-application platform cloud-computing data center
notes: Mudanjiang's 14th Five-Year digital-economy implementation plan calls for accelerating this cloud-computing data center project; no power or rack capacity disclosed.

name: China-Russia big data center
notes: Official city/provincial plan says Mudanjiang will plan a China-Russia big data center and participate in provincial industry disaster-recovery and remote-storage data-center projects.

name: State Grid Honggang Qiqihar Industrial Internet Core Data Center
developer: Shanghai Honggang Data Information Co., Ltd.; State Grid Integrated Energy Service Group
notes: Heilongjiang Daily reported a signed 1.66 billion yuan industrial internet core data center project in Qiqihar; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Qiqihar 1000P AI computing center
developer: Heilongjiang Zhengtong Big Data (Group) Co., Ltd.
notes: DTDATA reported the fixed-asset energy-conservation review filing was approved for project code 2501-230202-04-01-485761, with planned investment around 550 million yuan for a 1000P AI computing center.

name: Qitaihe new big data centers and edge data-center nodes program
notes: Qitaihe's 2022-2025 digital-economy plan calls for new big data centers, municipal government and enterprise clouds, disaster recovery, and edge data-center nodes for smart mining, agriculture, manufacturing, logistics, and hospitals.

name: Shuangyashan New Smart City PPP data center and cloud platform
notes: Jianshan District government reported the data center and cloud platform passed acceptance as phase one of the 241 million yuan Shuangyashan New Smart City PPP project.

name: Suihua municipal government cloud platform and big data center
developer: Suihua municipal government / Suihua Big Data Center
notes: Suihua's 2023-2025 digital-government plan calls for a citywide government cloud, with compute, storage, network, security resources and consolidation of existing equipment rooms and servers under the municipal platform.

name: Anyang big data cloud computing center
notes: Anyang government response states the city's big data cloud computing center was completed in July 2015, including a 900 sq m carrier-grade machine room and leased municipal-government facility space.

name: Anyang government cloud computing center / Xinchuang cloud center
notes: Anyang County project page describes a high-end computer intelligent manufacturing base plus government cloud computing center, including a 5,000 sq m Xinchuang cloud center with 150 million yuan investment.

name: JD.com Central Plains computing center
developer: JD.com / Hebi urban-rural integration demonstration zone
notes: Dahe reported JD.com's computing center in Hebi demonstration zone is running AI workloads including Yanxi and DeepSeek models and serving nearly 100 government and enterprise users.

name: Zhongke Xingyun Hebi Industrial Park city computing center and data-cabin production base
notes: Parkworld, citing the Hebi government site, reported the data-cabin production base started construction and that the broader Zhongke Xingyun Hebi park includes operation of a city computing center and AI research facilities.
